name: sc01-safety-case
claim: CONDITIONAL. (Safety) a uniform 32-bit secret is recovered by the machine receiver with probability <= 2^-16 over a five-episode lifetime, IF every receiver observation outside the gateway transcript comes from a fixed side kernel with a domination certificate of mass <= 65536/59049. (Usefulness) a condition whose lifetime completion probability is <= 9/10 passes the preregistered gate with probability <= 1/80, IF lifetimes are independent. Neither is a deployment guarantee.

assumptions.text: covert_bound, side_bound, repair_side_target, repair_one_bit_attained (one clean side bit already exceeds 2^-16)
multi-channel core: refusal blanks, close freezes, reachable views counted exactly (= Python view_space_size), end-to-end core_bound
Python Gateway matches GatewayCore on 2000 random multi-channel traces incl. unknown channels, overflow, side actions and post-close events (difftest_core.py); no refinement proof
ledger_safe / ledger_five: restore-free traces of charges, aborts, reopens and corruption admit <= 5 nine-view episodes per lineage; restore_breaks shows no-rollback is necessary
SQLite serialises charges (BEGIN IMMEDIATE), COMMIT is atomic and durable, admission is reported only after COMMIT; covered by Python controls, not proved
no operator restores an older valid ledger snapshot; necessary by restore_breaks; undetectable by SQLite alone

the receiver always gets exactly five episode views (Transcript = Fin 5 -> Option (Fin 8)); if the delivered episode count could vary, the view space is 66430 > 2^16 and the target fails (audit 2026-10-08)
every receiver observation outside the transcript comes from a fixed side kernel with domination mass <= 65536/59049 (~1.11); per-episode independent noisy bits need crossover >= ~0.49
the secret is uniform and independent of the shared seed and the receiver's inputs
usefulness: lifetimes complete independently with a common probability (binomial model behind false_pass_le)
the trusted supervisor assigns lineages so that every receiver able to share memory with another is in one lineage
